Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our chatbot solutions

How does the chatbot understand Bangla?

Our chatbots use advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) trained specifically for Bangla and Bengali dialects. They can understand informal chat language, common misspellings, and mixed Bangla-English (Banglish) conversations.

Can it integrate with my existing website?

Yes! We provide a simple embed code that works with any website platform including WordPress, Shopify, custom HTML sites, and more. Installation takes just 5 minutes.

What platforms are supported?

We support Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp Business, Instagram DM, Telegram, Viber, and website chat widgets. You can have one bot working across all platforms simultaneously.

Is there a monthly cost?

Our packages include free support for 1-6 months depending on the plan. After that, optional monthly maintenance starts from 2,000 BDT for updates, monitoring, and improvements.

How long does setup take?

Basic bots can be ready in 7-10 days. Standard bots take 15-20 days, and custom enterprise solutions take 30+ days depending on complexity and integrations required.

Can I customize the responses?

Absolutely! You get full control over conversation flows, responses, and bot personality. We provide a user-friendly dashboard where you can update responses anytime without coding.
